title: Just what I wanted
text: Just what I wanted. I was looking for some easy to care for napkins that would dress up my table without being too formal, and these perfectly fit the bill.  They do wrinkle, but I was ok with pulling them out of the dryer while they were the least bit damp and laying them flat while I smoothed them out with my hands.  I would order these again in a heartbeat!
